en: This is a vintage postcard with two sides shown. The front features large, bold letters reading 'GOD JUL!' filled with black-and-white images of buildings, likely landmarks or significant locations of a city, and decorated with pine branches and cones in the upper right corner, evoking a Christmas greeting. Handwritten script adds a personal message at the bottom. The back side is addressed in elegant handwriting to a recipient in Göteborg (Gothenburg), with printed text in Swedish and French ('Brefkort – Brevkort, Carte postale, Union postale universelle'), and a publisher's credit from Stockholm.
